user.title: Set up EnergyIQ
user.description: Select the whole-home power source and, if desired, restore existing EnergyIQ data.

init.title: EnergyIQ settings
init.description: Set the consumption limits used to color the Consumption graph. Each limit is for one 2-hour segment. Green is at or below Expected, yellow is above Expected through High, and red is above High. These settings do not change EnergyIQ's measured consumption or cost calculations.

error.high_must_be_at_least_expected: High limit must be at least the Expected limit.
